body:
# ✦ Quickvane

Essential quality of life keybinds & commands for every Minecraft player

![NeoForge 1.21.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-1.21.1-green?style=for-the-badge) ![NeoForge 1.21.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/MORE-SOON-orange?style=for-the-badge)

![Banner](https://cdn.modvane.com/mods/quickvane/listing/banner.webp?v=1)

## ✦ Features

`✦ Keybindings`

All commands below can be bound to any key for even faster access.  
You can do this through the normal keybind settings. (All unbound by default to avoid conflicts)

`✦ Gamemode Shortcuts`

Quick commands to switch gamemodes instantly.

*   `/gmc` or `/gc` - Set gamemode to creative
*   `/gms` or `/gs` - Set gamemode to survival
*   `/gma` or `/ga` - Set gamemode to adventure
*   `/gmp` or `/gp` - Set gamemode to spectator

`✦ Time Shortcuts`

Control the time of day with simple commands.

*   `/day` or `/d` - Set time to day
*   `/night` or `/n` - Set time to night

`✦ Weather Shortcuts`

Change the weather quickly.

*   `/sun` - Set weather to clear
*   `/rain` - Set weather to rain

`✦ Difficulty Shortcuts`

Adjust difficulty on the fly.

*   `/peaceful` or `/pc` - Set difficulty to peaceful
*   `/easy` or `/ez` - Set difficulty to easy
*   `/normal` or `/nm` - Set difficulty to normal
*   `/hard` or `/hd` - Set difficulty to hard

`✦ Player Utilities`

Take care of yourself quickly.

*   `/heal` - Restore full health, food, remove negative effects, and extinguish fire
*   `/feed` - Fill your hunger bar
